dialogs.about: 전시를 보고 돌아와 딸과 차를 마시며

lines.en: Mom, how was the exhibit today?
It was wonderful. I saw many paintings today.
lines.ko: 아주 멋졌어요. 오늘 그림을 많이 봤어요.

lines.en: Which one was the most impressive?
A dark sea painting. Very dramatic and powerful.
lines.ko: 어두운 바다 그림이요. 아주 극적이고 힘이 있어요.

lines.en: Did it make you feel sad?
A little melancholy, but also very touching.
I want to see it too.
Then we will go together next Sunday.
lines.ko: 그럼 다음 일요일에 같이 갈 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you, Mom. I am excited already.
Good. You will love the delicate flower room.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 섬세한 꽃 그림 방이 마음에 들 거예요.

lines.en: That was a long walk. Are you tired?
A little, but I feel happy now.
Which room did you like best?
The quiet one. The colors are in harmony.
lines.ko: 조용한 방이요. 색들이 서로 조화를 이뤄요.

lines.en: Yes! That big blue painting is impressive.
lines.ko: 맞아요! 그 큰 파란 그림은 인상적이에요.

lines.en: And that small one? It looks mysterious.
lines.ko: 그리고 저 작은 그림은요? 신비로워 보여요.

lines.en: Yes. The thin lines look delicate and lively.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 가는 선들이 섬세하고 생기 있어 보여요.

lines.en: Last week I did not see that.
Looking together is wonderful. Thank you for coming.
lines.ko: 같이 보니 참 좋아요. 와 줘서 고마워요.

lines.en: Thank you too. I will call you soon.
